name: std::range-default-formatter<std::range_format::sequence>

declarations.code:
template <ranges::input_range R, class CharT>

struct /*range-default-formatter*/<range_format::sequence, R, CharT>;

intro: The class template /*range-default-formatter*/ for range types is specialized for formatting range as a sequence of elements if std::format_kind<R> is std::range_format::sequence.
